summary: Tested the separate return pickup time for round bookings and the saved student places (home/uni), end to end. Backend pytest: 58 of 58 passed. This includes a new file, test_return_time_places.py, with 15 tests: a round booking without a return time returns 400 with the exact message, the return time persists, go and return bookings store null, an invalid return time returns 422, updating round to go clears the return time, a student round booking without a return time returns 400, and leg_time plus sorting on GO and RETURN trips. It also covers PUT /my/places (and 403 for admin), save_places mapping for go, return and unchecked, an admin booking with save_places updating the linked student, /accounts/lookup (admin returns the data or null, student gets 403, no password_hash), and account PUT with places. I updated the older tests to send return_pickup_time for round bookings, which are now required. UI checks in Playwright all passed except one bug: the admin dialog return-time select appears only for round, saving without it shows the toast 'حدد وقت التقاط رحلة الإياب', and saving with it works. Phone autofill shows the linked banner and toast and fills name, gender, addresses and coords. The save checkbox is checked by default. The bookings table, dispatch list and student card show 'إياب/الإياب <time>'. On the Trips tab the RETURN trip shows round passengers at their return time and in sorted order (2:00 م, 5:00 م); the GO trip uses pickup_time. The student saved-places card, edit dialog (map click and address) and PUT work. Student prefill works for go, return and round, and go<->return swaps the points. An unchecked booking leaves places unchanged; a checked one updates home. The admin accounts form shows PlacesFields and edits save. Regressions pass: 7-seat dispatch assign and driver portal legs and nav links. No page errors.

ui_bugs.issue: Switching between ROUND and RETURN does not swap the points, because only the go<->return pair is handled. Steps: in a new student booking (prefilled go: pickup=home) choose round, then return. The pickup labelled 'بغداد' still holds the HOME (Balad) coords and the dropoff holds UNI. With booking-save-places-checkbox checked (the default), saving stores the swapped points: the backend maps return location to uni and dropoff to home, so the student's saved home and uni get SWAPPED. It also gives a wrong return booking. Fix: treat round like go, swapping whenever the 'return' side changes (for example swap if (old==='return') !== (new==='return')).

action_items: Fix BookingFields trip-type switch: swap location/dropoff whenever moving to or from 'return' (round->return and return->round as well as go<->return). Otherwise saved places get swapped.
critical_code_review_comments: useStudentAutofill/mergeStudent only fills empty fields. If the admin first types phone A (autofilled) and then changes it to phone B, the name, gender and points of student A stay, and the banner shows B. Consider resetting the autofilled fields when the linked student changes.

The admin checkbox defaults to checked, so any admin booking for a phone that belongs to an existing student silently overwrites that student's saved places with the booking's points. Consider defaulting it to unchecked for admin, or showing it only when a student is linked.
prepare_booking writes places to the user before the booking insert. This is harmless but not atomic.
PUT /accounts always overwrites the home/uni fields from the body, so any client that omits them clears the saved places. Today the form always sends them, which is OK.
server.py is about 850 lines, over the 700-line guideline. Split it into routers.
